subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the details of our upcoming travel itinerary for the business conference next month. We have booked flights for the team and reserved rooms at the conference hotel. Attached is the full itinerary for your reference. If you have any questions or need further information, please feel free to reach out. Looking forward to a successful trip! Best regards, [Your Name]
